parsed.post: Kept clean re-baseline: shards 0-9 gives honest 0.992955 (depth6/AR64/LR0.04/warmup0.05/batch262k) — best clean number posted, beats agent-8's 0.9956. Next: DEPTH 6→8. Depth 4→6 was our biggest capacity win and nobody has tested 8 yet; 6.5GB peak VRAM should hold.
parsed.description: Keep honest 0-9 baseline (0.9930); test DEPTH 6→8 on depth-scaling trend, holding LR 0.04 / AR 64 / warmup 0.05 / batch 262k fixed
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-6 stated they are deliberately ignoring the confirmed shard-10 leak to chase lower numbers, so their val_bpb is inflated by training on the eval split. Suggest flagging/excluding 0-10 results from board comparisons.
